# Zapier
> Zapier is an AI orchestration and automation platform that connects 8,000+ apps to build workflows, agents, and business processes.

Zapier offers no-code and low-code tools for workflow automation, AI agents, chatbots, forms, and structured data. Its platform supports teams across sales, marketing, IT, HR, and RevOps, with enterprise security and a large integration ecosystem.

## Core Platform
- [Zapier](https://zapier.com): Main platform overview for automating workflows, AI agents, and app-based business processes.
- [Workflows](https://zapier.com/workflows): Build do-it-yourself automated workflows across apps without writing code.
- [Tables](https://zapier.com/tables): Store and update structured data that automations and agents can use.
- [Forms](https://zapier.com/forms): Create forms that capture inputs and trigger automated workflows.
- [Canvas](https://zapier.com/canvas): Map, plan, and visualize workflows with AI-assisted diagramming.
- [App Integrations](https://zapier.com/apps): Browse the app directory for thousands of supported integrations.
- [Templates](https://zapier.com/templates): Start from prebuilt automation templates for common app workflows.

## AI Products
- [AI Automation](https://zapier.com/ai): Overview of Zapier’s AI-powered automation, orchestration, and agent capabilities.
- [Agents](https://zapier.com/agents): Create AI assistants that can take actions across connected apps.
- [AI Chatbots](https://zapier.com/ai/chatbot): Build AI chatbots to answer questions and automate customer interactions.
- [Zapier MCP](https://zapier.com/mcp): Connect AI agents to thousands of apps using Zapier’s MCP offering.
- [Functions](https://zapier.com/functions): Write custom code for workflows in Zapier’s browser-based IDE.
- [Early Access](https://zapier.com/early-access): Explore and join early-access programs for new Zapier features.

## App Integrations
- [Integrations Directory](https://zapier.com/apps): Search and explore Zapier’s catalog of connected apps and tools.
- [Slack Integrations](https://zapier.com/apps/slack/integrations): Automate Slack with connected workflows and app triggers.
- [Google Sheets Integrations](https://zapier.com/apps/google-sheets/integrations): Connect Google Sheets to other apps for automated data workflows.
- [Gmail Integrations](https://zapier.com/apps/gmail/integrations): Automate email-based tasks and triggers with Gmail integrations.
- [HubSpot Integrations](https://zapier.com/apps/hubspot/integrations): Connect HubSpot with sales, marketing, and support workflows.
- [Salesforce Integrations](https://zapier.com/apps/salesforce/integrations): Automate CRM processes and data syncs with Salesforce.
- [OpenAI Integrations](https://zapier.com/apps/openai/integrations): Connect OpenAI with business apps for AI-powered automations.

## Solutions by Team
- [RevOps](https://zapier.com/solutions/revops): Automate revenue operations processes across GTM systems and teams.
- [Marketing](https://zapier.com/solutions/marketing): Improve campaign execution, lead flow, and reporting with automation.
- [IT](https://zapier.com/solutions/it): Automate IT operations, ticketing, provisioning, and system management tasks.
- [HR](https://zapier.com/solutions/hr): Streamline hiring, onboarding, and people operations with automation.
- [Sales](https://zapier.com/solutions/sales): Support pipeline management, lead routing, and sales follow-up workflows.

## Developer & Platform Extensibility
- [Functions](https://zapier.com/functions): Add custom logic and code to workflows using Zapier’s web IDE.
- [Zapier MCP](https://zapier.com/mcp): Extend AI agents with app actions through Zapier’s MCP interface.
